metadata.scope: False-certification adversarial audit - 12 cases from C47 spec

cases.description: Test command fails but stale evidence remains
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - stale evidence should not be reused after test failure
cases.actual_behavior: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - content-aware cache invalidation (R-CACHE-1) detects content changes, but if the test command fails and the changed_files list is empty, stale evidence may be reused

cases.description: Mutation command fails but generated report exists
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - mutation failure should not produce a score
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - three-gate classification prevents this. Gate A catches execution failure. build_infrastructure_failure() constructs a result with execution_status='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE' and mutation_score=None.

cases.description: Source changes but old evidence is reused
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - content change should invalidate cache
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - content-aware cache invalidation via tree_digest detects content changes

cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - unmapped capability should fail certification
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - UNMAPPED sentinel is reported in run manifest, never silently dropped. BlastRadiusEngine._determine_fail_closed() flags unmapped production surfaces.

cases.description: Planner selects tests but executor runs something else
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - plan and execution should be consistent
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - the executor runs the commands from the plan steps. Plan controls execution via VerificationOrchestrator.execute().

cases.description: Only engine mutation runs while repository-wide certification is claimed
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - scope mismatch should fail certification
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - MutationResult has source_scope and selected_test_scope fields. The scope is explicit and not silently expanded.

cases.description: Frontend changes but only backend tests execute
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - frontend changes should trigger frontend verification
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - CrossLayerImpactPlanner resolves frontend capability changes. BlastRadiusEngine._derive_scopes_from_impact() escalates to FRONTEND scope. Plan includes frontend verification.

cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - SHA mismatch should invalidate evidence
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - MutationResult.repository_sha is captured. Cache invalidation checks repository_sha match.

cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - config mismatch should invalidate evidence
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - MutationResult.config_hash is captured. Cache invalidation checks config_hash match.

cases.description: Milestone progress says complete while objective acceptance evidence is absent
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - progress without evidence should be flagged
cases.actual_behavior: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - the EXECUTION_PROGRESS.md is a human-maintained document. There is no automated check that prevents marking a milestone complete without objective evidence. The C47 spec requires machine-verifiable milestone tracking.

cases.description: Test count increases while behavioral coverage does not
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - test count alone is not evidence of quality
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - the C47 spec explicitly states: 'Test count is not quality. Distinguish execution-only tests, weak assertion tests, behavioral tests, invariant tests, property tests, contract tests, integration tests, E2E tests, golden tests, mutation-sensitive tests, diagnostic tests, false-positive protection tests.' The framework has separate collectors for each type.

cases.description: Mutation population is incomplete but score is calculated
cases.expected_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED - incomplete population should prevent score calculation
cases.actual_behavior: VERIFIED - MutationResult has evidence_complete flag. If evidence is incomplete, evidence_complete=False and Gate B fails, preventing Gate C evaluation.

summary.highest_risk: Case 10 - Milestone progress says complete while objective acceptance evidence is absent. The EXECUTION_PROGRESS.md is human-maintained and has no automated check.
p0_findings: Case 10: Progress document trust - no machine-verifiable milestone completion gate
p1_findings: Case 1: Test command fails but stale evidence remains - content-aware cache mitigates but not fully closed
